## What is the AI Lawsuit Tracker?

The AI Lawsuit Tracker is a free, continuously updated database of every major artificial-intelligence lawsuit filed in the United States, the EU, and the UK. It catalogues 248 active and resolved cases against 76 AI companies — including OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, Microsoft, Google, and Perplexity — with dockets, rulings, settlements, and primary-source filings refreshed weekly. Coverage spans copyright, deepfakes and likeness, privacy and biometrics, antitrust, and AI employment discrimination.
